Mukhar turns your talk into text on your phone. Nothing leaves your device. It needs a one-time download of about 40 MB per language (Wi-Fi recommended). Offline transcripts are less accurate: Mukhar may miss some \"um\"s and mishear names or mixed Hindi-English, so filler counts are estimates and there are no grammar fixes. Pace and pauses are accurate.
Download English (36 MB) · Download Hindi (42 MB): coming in the next update. Your talks are saved until then.

Paste your own Deepgram or Sarvam key (speech-to-text) and Anthropic key (coaching) in Settings → Your keys. Your phone sends the recording and transcript straight to those companies under your account. Mukhar never sees your keys or your audio. You pay them directly, about ₹1.6 for a 3-minute talk.
